messages:
ana: Quick thread: noticed p99 spike on /v1/chat in the dashboard that doesn't appear in the APIGW logs. p50/p95 look normal. link: https://dash.redwood/trace/xyz

raj: Could be that dashboard mixes client-side timing with server-side service_time. Are we sure the series is service_time_ms?

ana: Yep, query says service_time_ms. But the percentiles are rollups from ingest nodes, some tagged with caller=proxy and some with caller=service. If proxy adds extra hop, that could explain p99.

metrics-bot: ingest/rollup: detected tag-mix caller=proxy (n=3) caller=service (n=297)

ui-team: UI request: show a small legend that lists caller counts and let users toggle to "exclude caller=proxy" for the chart.

raj: Also interesting: our approx_percentile implementation discards series with count < 5 when merging, but apparently the tags still affect the shape. We need clear semantics: merged percentile should only reflect series that match the chosen tag filters.

ana: Good point. I think the mismatch happened because routing policy temporarily injected a proxy for a small cohort (latency-sampling feature), which increased tail but only for a handful of requests. Dashboard showed p99 spike because frontend didn't exclude proxy-tagged rollups.

ui-team: Short term: add tag-filter toggle and sample-counts in tooltip. Long term: change merge semantics to attach per-tag counts and respect client filters at display time.

raj: Let's also add a confidence indicator for percentiles: low sample or mixed-tag -> show a caution icon. That helps oncall triage.

ana: Filed ENGPLAT-1442 for tag-aware rollup semantics and ENGPLAT-1443 for UI changes.

metrics-bot: note: rollout/feature-inject-proxy changed policy at=2025-03-12T17:02:01Z user=ana

ui-team: We'll prototype the toggle and badge. If timeline holds, we can ship the tooltip in the next patch.

ana: Thanks all, will add a brief note in the incident doc to avoid chasing phantom p99s.
